references.title: Street Fighter 6 - Guile Gameplay Trailer
observed: A detached thin ring remains in the air at 41.25 seconds while the body prepares another arm motion.
At 41.50 to 41.667 seconds a localized hand flash and thin leading line reach the existing ring.
At 41.75 to 41.833 seconds a finite bright leading surface and backward flowing thin edges remain distinct, with visible empty interior.
The localized target impact follows at 41.917 seconds.
references.projectInterpretation: Borrow finite leading surface, open interior, and detached release grammar for an original C-shaped ki blade.
limits: The video does not label the move. The observed source is circular/ring-like, so it is not evidence for a move literally named crescent or a confirmed Sonic Cross variant.

references.title: KOF XV｜TERRY BOGARD｜Trailer #10【TEAM FATAL FURY】
observed: The hand/body descend toward the ground before the first small floor flash.
At 39.083 seconds the user holds a low release posture and a small ground flash precedes the much taller target column at 39.167 seconds.
The column keeps its base on the floor while its volume expands and the target moves upward.
The upper volume breaks away around 39.667 seconds while thin floor residue remains.
references.projectInterpretation: Ground transfer followed by a single sustained floor-anchored column with internal hit pressure, rather than repeated round midair explosions.
limits: No move name HUD is visible; a precise Power Geyser variant was not identified. Ataho's existing hammerfist does not touch the floor, so the implementation uses a visible hand-to-floor conduit rather than claiming a ground punch.

references.title: Guilty Gear -Strive- Starter Guide - Venom
observed: Several small blue balls preserve separate positions at different heights during 70 to 74 seconds.
Between 74.25 and 74.625 seconds an active ball becomes pink/purple and moves right while other blue balls remain.
Between 74.875 and 75.125 seconds a low arm motion and another active ball take a lower route, while a higher ball remains.
At 75.50 to 75.875 seconds the upward arm/weapon path coincides with a higher ball becoming active.
At 76.125 to 76.625 seconds staggered target flashes coexist with active traveling and still placed balls.
references.projectInterpretation: Keep fixed waiting orbs, activate only the selected orb before each launch, then remove only that orb and accelerate independent trajectories.
limits: No original game input or ball collision rules were executed. Exact input-to-ball selection is not claimed. The giant orb sequence at 297 to 302 seconds was inspected but excluded from the small-orb design.
